exposure: Timing of artificial rupture of membranes (AROM) (<4 cm vs. ≥4 cm)
outcome: Composite of maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes
cohort: Preterm patients (23-34 weeks gestation) undergoing indicated induction of labor at a single tertiary care center from 2011 to 2014
finding: Early AROM (<4 cm) was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery in preterm patients undergoing indicated induction of labor.
